name: autoresearch
description: Autonomous experiment loop for ZCode: set a goal, pick a mechanical metric, and let the agent iterate — measure, keep what works, revert what doesn't, repeat. Provides init/run/log experiment tools (MCP), a loop protocol skill, guardrails (frozen benchmark, checks backpressure, memory injection, Stop continuation), and a static dashboard export.

description_i18n.en: Autonomous experiment loop for ZCode: set a goal, pick a mechanical metric, and let the agent iterate — measure, keep what works, revert what doesn't, repeat.
description_i18n.zh-CN: ZCode 自主实验循环：设定目标与机械度量，让 agent 迭代——测量、保留有效改动、回滚无效改动、循环往复。

maxIterations.title: Max Iterations
maxIterations.description: Default iteration cap per experiment segment. Overridable per session via .auto/config.json.

checksTimeoutMs.title: Checks Timeout (ms)
checksTimeoutMs.description: Wall-clock timeout for the correctness check script (.auto/checks.sh).
